Only my test file exists, and the full run (106 tests) already passed cleanly.

I extensively probed the implementation against its documented contract (including scratch experiments I cleaned up afterward) looking for discrepancies, but every behavior I checked — hex/octal boundary promotion, Float→Double fallback on overflow, sign handling, NaN propagation in min/max, blank-string handling in `isCreatable`, etc. — matched the documented/expected behavior exactly. All 106 tests pass, and I did not find a bug in this class to report.
